question: Which of the following dynasties controlled the Silk Route during post Mauryan period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kushanas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Kushanas:

 
 
• **The Kushanas were a Central Asian dynasty that ruled over a vast empire covering parts of present-day India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Central Asia.**
 
• The Kushanas played a significant role in fostering cultural and commercial exchanges between Central Asia and India.
 
• **They controlled the Silk Route during post Mauryan period.**
